records.subject: ASTRONOM
records.title: Astronomy
records.description: Overview of the solar system, stars, galaxies, cosmology, and the history of astronomy. Includes a lab component with occasional evening meetings. Credit not granted for both ASTRONOM 135 and 150.

records.subject: ASTRONOM
records.title: Planets and Planetary Systems
records.description: Formation and dynamics of planetary systems; major planets: interiors, surfaces, atmospheres; minor planets: moons, asteroids, comets; science missions; extrasolar planets.

records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: 4 credits of PHYSICS 202, or PHYSICS 202 and 212, or PHYSICS 206; MATH 172 or 182.
records.description: Planets, the sun, stars, and galaxies; current topics in astrophysics and planetary research.
